name: catapult_throw
description: The catapult launch sequence with the release: the bow, rise_and_drop and lunge of catapult_launch, with the jaw opening a few degrees INSIDE the lunge frame (set jaw 26: the object leaves once the jaw has opened past its width, late in the swing for a small angle and early for a large one, so that angle is the release-time knob: `--set lunge.jaw=30`), then the jaw fully open at speed 0 and back to the stand. The claw swings down as the legs begin to rise and back up fast as they finish. Played with `g2script catapult_throw --amount 1.0` (add `--pick` to play pickF first).
